checks.statement: Use a card to group related content and actions about one subject; let its dimensions follow its contents.
checks.condition: When presenting content in a card.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Cards guidance.

evidence.result: The specimen groups title, supporting text, and icon in one interactive card, but does not represent a real subject or content-driven sizing case.

implementation.notes: The specimen groups title, supporting text, and icon in one interactive card, but does not represent a real subject or content-driven sizing case.

checks.statement: Make a card directly actionable only when its main destination/action is clear; otherwise keep the card as a container and make its individual links or buttons actionable.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Usage guidance.

evidence.result: This component showcase renders every card as one button with no nested action; it does not expose a non-actionable-container mode for cards with separate actions.

implementation.notes: This component showcase renders every card as one button with no nested action; it does not expose a non-actionable-container mode for cards with separate actions.

checks.statement: Avoid making multiple independent actions on one card compete with the card’s primary action.
checks.condition: When a card contains more than one action.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Usage guidance.

evidence.result: The preview has one card-level button action and no independent actions to compare.

implementation.notes: The preview has one card-level button action and no independent actions to compare.

checks.statement: Use elevation only when separation from the background is needed; use filled or outlined variants to establish other card treatments.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Container guidance.

evidence.result: Generated elevated/filled/outlined variants map container, elevation, outline, and shape tokens into the shared card surface.

implementation.notes: Generated elevated/filled/outlined variants map container, elevation, outline, and shape tokens into the shared card surface.

checks.statement: Keep content and actions in the same semantic order as card layouts adapt to larger screens.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Adaptive design guidance.

evidence.result: The single card specimen has no responsive card collection or adaptive order.

implementation.notes: The single card specimen has no responsive card collection or adaptive order.

checks.statement: Provide a single-pointer alternative for dragging or swiping a card, such as choosing the same action from a menu.
checks.condition: When cards can be dragged or dismissed.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Behavior guidance.

evidence.result: The card implementation exposes no drag or swipe behavior, so no alternative for such an action is required by this component path.

implementation.notes: The card implementation exposes no drag or swipe behavior, so no alternative for such an action is required by this component path.

checks.statement: Make directly actionable cards tab stops; for non-actionable cards, do not focus the container but make each actionable child a tab stop.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Focus guidance.

evidence.result: The direct-action card is a native button and therefore a tab stop; the specimen has no non-actionable card wrapper.

implementation.notes: The direct-action card is a native button and therefore a tab stop; the specimen has no non-actionable card wrapper.

checks.statement: Give actionable cards a button or link role according to their behavior; non-actionable cards need no role, and hide purely decorative images from screen readers.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Labeling elements guidance.

evidence.result: The actionable card is rendered as a native button; the check icon is decorative content within that button.

implementation.notes: The actionable card is rendered as a native button; the check icon is decorative content within that button.

checks.statement: Use a card for scannable, related content and actions on one topic; choose elevated, filled, or outlined by visual style because all three support the same legibility and functionality.
checks.condition: When deciding whether and how to use a card.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Usage instructions.

evidence.result: The preview exposes elevated, filled and outlined interactive card variants, but product legibility and topic suitability are application-level choices.

implementation.notes: The preview exposes elevated, filled and outlined interactive card variants, but product legibility and topic suitability are application-level choices.

checks.statement: Use grids, vertical lists, or carousels for card collections, but prefer open spacing, headlines, or dividers when those create a simpler hierarchy than cards.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Usage instructions.

evidence.result: The specimen displays one card and does not represent an information architecture or card collection.

implementation.notes: The specimen displays one card and does not represent an information architecture or card collection.

checks.statement: The container is the only required card element; size it to its contents and express elevation through the container.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Container instructions.

evidence.result: The card is the sole required wrapper, contains title/supporting text/icon, and its dimensions follow its content with padding.

implementation.notes: The card is the sole required wrapper, contains title/supporting text/icon, and its dimensions follow its content with padding.

checks.statement: Group card content into blocks and use visual emphasis to communicate each element’s importance.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Content blocks instructions.

evidence.result: The template provides title and supporting-text spans but no distinct typography hierarchy rules for those spans in the card stylesheet.

implementation.notes: The template provides title and supporting-text spans but no distinct typography hierarchy rules for those spans in the card stylesheet.

checks.statement: Use full-width dividers for content that expands and inset dividers for related content within a card.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Dividers instructions.

evidence.result: The sample card contains no divider.

implementation.notes: The sample card contains no divider.

checks.statement: Avoid placing text or icons over images; if necessary, ensure accessible contrast and add a translucent scrim or bounding shape beneath the foreground content.
checks.condition: When text or icons overlay a card image.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Layering text, icons, and images instructions.

evidence.result: No image or overlaid text/icon appears in this card specimen.

implementation.notes: No image or overlaid text/icon appears in this card specimen.

checks.statement: A card may act as one large touch target that opens expanded detail; other card content may include buttons, icon buttons, selection controls, linked text, and an overflow menu.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Primary action area instructions.

evidence.result: The card is one large native button target and contains no nested actions, matching the allowed single-action area.

implementation.notes: The card is one large native button target and contains no nested actions, matching the allowed single-action area.

checks.statement: Place a card overflow menu in the upper-right or lower-right corner.
checks.condition: When a card has an overflow menu.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Primary action area instructions.

evidence.result: The specimen has no overflow menu.

implementation.notes: The specimen has no overflow menu.

checks.statement: Cards in a collection share the same resting elevation by default; elevation changes when a card is picked up or dragged.
checks.condition: For cards displayed in a collection.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Cards in a collection instructions.

evidence.result: The component specimen renders a single card, not a collection with comparable resting elevations.

implementation.notes: The component specimen renders a single card, not a collection with comparable resting elevations.

checks.statement: Apply collection filters to every card and place filter or sort controls outside the card collection.
checks.condition: When a card collection can be filtered or sorted.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Filtering and sorting instructions.

evidence.result: No card collection or collection-level filter/sort control is present.

implementation.notes: No card collection or collection-level filter/sort control is present.

checks.statement: Adapt card orientation and content space to large-screen ergonomics, such as changing a compact horizontal card into a larger vertical card with more room for images and text.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Ergonomics instructions.

evidence.result: The single preview card has no breakpoint-specific orientation or media layout.

implementation.notes: The single preview card has no breakpoint-specific orientation or media layout.

checks.statement: Use spacing to adjust content-focused cards so they fill the screen region suited to the device breakpoint.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Visual presentation instructions.

evidence.result: The card preview does not adapt to device breakpoint content regions.

implementation.notes: The card preview does not adapt to device breakpoint content regions.

checks.statement: On compact mobile layouts, cards may fill screen width; on expanded screens use multiple columns and organize related cards in rows or carousels rather than stretching UI across the screen.
checks.condition: When choosing card layouts across breakpoints.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Column-based layouts instructions.

evidence.result: Collection columns and expanded-screen layout are owned by the consuming page, not this standalone card specimen.

implementation.notes: Collection columns and expanded-screen layout are owned by the consuming page, not this standalone card specimen.

checks.statement: At compact breakpoints, consider replacing cards with compact lists while retaining controls, actions, and other component-specific elements.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Small screens instructions.

evidence.result: The component preview does not choose between card and list presentation at compact breakpoints.

implementation.notes: The component preview does not choose between card and list presentation at compact breakpoints.

checks.statement: Use container-transform expansion only for expressive hero moments; reveal additional information by expanding the card rather than scrolling within it.
checks.condition: When card content requires more space.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Expanding instructions.

evidence.result: Interactive cards have button feedback and focus styling but no expansion/content-reveal or container-transform behavior.

implementation.notes: Interactive cards have button feedback and focus styling but no expansion/content-reveal or container-transform behavior.

checks.statement: Cards may use a forward/backward transition to navigate between consecutive levels of screen hierarchy.
checks.condition: When a card navigates to a related detail screen.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Navigation instructions.

evidence.result: No card navigation transition or forward/backward hierarchy animation is present in the inspected card component path.

implementation.notes: No card navigation transition or forward/backward hierarchy animation is present in the inspected card component path.

checks.statement: A swipe may act on one card at a time anywhere on that card, but assign only one swipe action and do not include swipeable content such as an image carousel or pagination.
checks.condition: When swipe gestures are supported on cards.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Swipe instructions.

evidence.result: No card swipe gesture is implemented in this path.

implementation.notes: No card swipe gesture is implemented in this path.

checks.statement: When a card is picked up to reorder it, raise its elevation and display it above all elements except app bars and navigation; do not push other elements aside.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Pick up & move instructions.

evidence.result: Card has no drag/reorder behavior or picked-up elevation state.

implementation.notes: Card has no drag/reorder behavior or picked-up elevation state.

checks.statement: On mobile, do not scroll content inside a card; truncate content beyond the maximum height and reveal it by expanding the card, which may then scroll within the screen.
checks.condition: On mobile when card content exceeds its maximum height.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Scrolling instructions.

evidence.result: The sample has short fixed content and no mobile-specific overflow/expand interaction.

implementation.notes: The sample has short fixed content and no mobile-specific overflow/expand interaction.

checks.statement: On desktop, card content may expand and scroll within the card.
checks.condition: On desktop when card content exceeds its initial height.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Scrolling on desktop instructions.

evidence.result: The sample has no long desktop card content or inner scrolling region.

implementation.notes: The sample has no long desktop card content or inner scrolling region.

checks.statement: Allow assistive technology users to reach both a card and its contents, and provide input-appropriate feedback.
checks.condition: For cards and their interactive contents.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Use cases instructions.

evidence.result: Native button supplies an actionable focus target and its text content contributes to its accessible name; icon is decorative span content.

implementation.notes: Native button supplies an actionable focus target and its text content contributes to its accessible name; icon is decorative span content.

checks.statement: Make a card either a directly actionable surface with no buttons or links inside, or a non-actionable container for those actions; do not stack actions on an actionable surface.
checks.condition: When a card includes interactive elements.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Interaction & style instructions.

evidence.result: The entire card is one button containing only noninteractive spans; no nested button/link is present.

implementation.notes: The entire card is one button containing only noninteractive spans; no nested button/link is present.

checks.statement: Show a touch ripple across a directly actionable card; non-actionable cards do not ripple.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Touch instructions.

evidence.result: Shared feedback runtime classifies `.md-interactive-card` as a button control and creates pointer-origin ripple feedback for pointer/touch activation.

implementation.notes: Shared feedback runtime classifies `.md-interactive-card` as a button control and creates pointer-origin ripple feedback for pointer/touch activation.

checks.statement: Show a hover cue and click ripple on directly actionable cards; non-actionable cards have no hover state.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Cursor instructions.

evidence.result: Card has state-layer variables and ripple support, but no card-specific hover selector is present in authored card CSS; token-generated hover roles need browser computed-style confirmation.

implementation.notes: Card has state-layer variables and ripple support, but no card-specific hover selector is present in authored card CSS; token-generated hover roles need browser computed-style confirmation.

checks.statement: Show a focus indicator on actionable elements; Space or Enter activates a focused card or element, and menu items support arrow navigation, Space/Enter selection, and Tab exit.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Keyboard instructions.

evidence.result: Actionable card has focus-visible outline and shared button runtime recognizes Enter/Space for interactive cards; native button dispatches activation.

implementation.notes: Actionable card has focus-visible outline and shared button runtime recognizes Enter/Space for interactive cards; native button dispatches activation.

checks.statement: Directly actionable cards are tab stops; non-actionable card containers are not, but every actionable child is a tab stop before focus moves to the next card.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Focus instructions.

evidence.result: Each rendered card is a native button, so it is a single tab stop; there are no internal action controls in the button.

implementation.notes: Each rendered card is a native button, so it is a single tab stop; there are no internal action controls in the button.

checks.statement: Tab moves to the next actionable element, or to the next card when cards themselves are actionable; Space or Enter confirms the focused action.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Keyboard navigation instructions.

evidence.result: The card is native button markup, which supports Tab focus and Space/Enter activation.

implementation.notes: The card is native button markup, which supports Tab focus and Space/Enter activation.

checks.statement: Let a user tap or press and hold a draggable card to open a menu that can change its position in the list; the menu may also offer card deletion.
checks.condition: When a card supports dragging or swiping.
checks.notes: The source gives tapping or press-and-hold as a concrete single-pointer route to reorder and notes deletion as an optional menu action.

sourceHistory.summary: The source gives tapping or press-and-hold as a concrete single-pointer route to reorder and notes deletion as an optional menu action.

evidence.result: No draggable/swipeable card behavior exists in the implementation path.

implementation.notes: No draggable/swipeable card behavior exists in the implementation path.

checks.statement: Avoid placing the action menu over a card in its draggable state; if it must overlay the card, ensure the menu interaction can be completed and does not cover the card.
checks.condition: When exposing single-pointer actions for a draggable card.
checks.notes: Preserves the recommendation against overlay placement and its conditional usability exception.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves the recommendation against overlay placement and its conditional usability exception.

evidence.result: No draggable state or action menu is implemented for the card.
